job_text:
Full Stack Software Engineer - Harbor Analytics

About the role
Join a small product team that owns features from database to browser. You will work across the stack and help shape how we build software.

Requirements
- 2+ years of experience building web applications
- Proficiency with React on the frontend
- Experience writing backend services in Node.js
- Comfortable designing and querying SQL databases
- Experience with Git-based team workflows

Nice to have
- Experience deploying applications with Docker
- Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines
- Exposure to GraphQL

Benefits
- Competitive salary and equity
- Remote-first culture
